assignee_email.description: Primary email address or me; mutually exclusive with assignee_id. Resolves one non-suspended agent/admin before updating.

include_usage.description: Request usage for 1h, 24h, 7d and 30d. Requires a supported Zendesk plan; absent statistics are not zero.

exact_name.description: Compare the returned full name to query, ignoring outer whitespace and case.

execution_mode.description: For closed status only; defaults to preview when closing.
